|game_text=If opponent's starship is about to move through hyperspace, target that starship and its highest-ability pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; pilot's ability, starship may not move this turn. If destiny = pilot's ability, starship is lost.

|rulings=* Can be played as a response to any hyperspace movement, including (for example) [[Hyper Escape]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Gravity%20Shadow</ref>

* If multiple permanent pilots and/or character pilots are tied for highest ability, Dark chooses one to target.
